raags.name: Raag Yaman
raags.aaroh: Ni Re Ga Ma# Dha Ni Ṡa
raags.avaroh: Ṡa Ni Dha Pa Ma# Ga Re Sa
raags.description: One of the most popular and widely sung raags. Its tivra (sharp) Madhyam gives it a bright, uplifting character. Ideal for beginners.

raags.name: Raag Bhairav
raags.aaroh: Sa Re♭ Ga Ma Pa Dha♭ Ni Ṡa
raags.avaroh: Ṡa Ni Dha♭ Pa Ma Ga Re♭ Sa
raags.description: A morning raag with two komal (flat) notes — Re and Dha. Its serious, meditative character makes it one of the most revered raags.

raags.name: Raag Kafi
raags.aaroh: Sa Re Ma Pa Dha Ṡa
raags.avaroh: Ṡa Ni♭ Dha Pa Ma Ga♭ Re Sa
raags.description: Raag Kafi is associated with the spring season and Holi. Its komal Ga and komal Ni give it a characteristic playful and light feeling.

raags.name: Raag Bhopali
raags.aaroh: Sa Re Ga Pa Dha Ṡa
raags.avaroh: Ṡa Dha Pa Ga Re Sa
raags.description: A pentatonic raag using only 5 notes. Its simplicity makes it perfect for beginners. Often used in folk and film music.

raags.name: Raag Durga
raags.aaroh: Sa Re Ma Pa Dha Ṡa
raags.avaroh: Ṡa Dha Pa Ma Re Sa
raags.description: Another pentatonic raag (Audhav jati). Named after Goddess Durga, it has a devotional character. Omits Ga and Ni.

raags.name: Raag Marwa
raags.aaroh: Ni Re♭ Ga Ma# Dha Ni Ṡa
raags.avaroh: Ṡa Ni Dha Ma# Ga Re♭ Ni Sa
raags.description: Raag Marwa is a uniquely complex raag — it omits Pa and uses komal Re and tivra Ma. Its evening character is distinctly contemplative.

raags.name: Raag Todi
raags.aaroh: Sa Re♭ Ga♭ Ma# Pa Dha♭ Ni Ṡa
raags.avaroh: Ṡa Ni Dha♭ Pa Ma# Ga♭ Re♭ Sa
raags.description: One of the most complex and emotionally powerful raags. Uses three komal notes and tivra Ma. Master-level raag requiring deep practice.

raags.name: Raag Bhairavi
raags.aaroh: S r g m P d n S'
raags.avroh: S' n d P m g r S
raags.pakad: S r g m, P d n S'
raags.description: A versatile and highly popular morning raag, often performed at the end of concerts. It uses all flat (komal) notes: r, g, d, n.

raags.name: Raag Darbari
raags.aaroh: S R g m P d n S'
raags.avroh: S' d n P, m P g, m R S
raags.pakad: R n S, D n P, m P g, m R S
raags.description: A deeply majestic, serious late-night raag created by Tansen. It is characterized by slow, heavy oscillations (andolan) on Ga and Dha.

raags.name: Raag Asavari
raags.aaroh: S R m P d S'
raags.avroh: S' n d P, m P d m P g, R S
raags.pakad: R m P, n d P, m P d m P g, R S
raags.description: A melancholy morning raag that evokes feelings of longing and renunciation.
